function.description: Call ANY contract with your own ABI-encoded calldata — the verb for a protocol nobody integrated ahead of time (an Aave supply, an NFT mint, a staking deposit). You declare BOTH directions: at most this much leaves, AT LEAST this much must come back, and the simulation decides whether that held. Declare receive_token + receive_min_raw whenever the call returns a fungible token: with no declared receipt the guard only bounds what leaves. Under a run's target_token a receipt of the target MUST be declared. dry_run defaults to TRUE.
function.name: defi_trade_call

allow_max_raw.description: The most raw units allow_spender may be granted.

allow_spender.description: Address this call is EXPECTED to grant an allowance to, if any. An undeclared allowance grant is always refused.

args.description: function: the arguments in order (addresses as 0x strings, integers as numbers or decimal strings, bytes as 0x hex).

calldata.description: ABI-encoded calldata, 0x-prefixed: the 4-byte selector followed by the encoded arguments. Or leave it empty and give function + args.

chain.description: Chain to call on — CHOOSE IT DELIBERATELY, because the same address is a different token on a different chain. Chains that can move value: ethereum, base, robinhood, arbitrum, polygon. Gas differs by orders of magnitude, so a cent-scale trade can cost more in gas on ethereum than it is worth, while base is a fraction of a cent. Per-chain guidance: the `chain` parameter of defi_trade.swap.

dry_run.description: TRUE (default) simulates and asserts without broadcasting.

function.description: Instead of calldata: the function signature, e.g. "mint(address,string)"; the tool encodes it with args. Give calldata OR function, not both.

max_spend_usd.description: The most USD you authorize to leave the wallet on this call.

receive_min_raw.description: The MINIMUM raw units of receive_token the simulation must measure coming back. This is the assertion that makes arbitrary calldata safe to sign. Leave 0 only for a call that genuinely receives nothing: at 0 NO return is checked and the guard only bounds what leaves.

receive_token.description: CONTRACT ADDRESS of the token this call must RETURN, when it returns one. Required if receive_min_raw is set.

spend_max_raw.description: The most RAW units of spend_token the call may move out. 0 with a spend_token declared means 'this call must not move that token'.

spend_token.description: CONTRACT ADDRESS of the token this call SPENDS, or null when it spends native (or nothing). The simulated outflow is asserted against spend_max_raw.

value.description: NATIVE value to send with the call, in whole coin units (0.01 = 0.01 ETH, converted at 18 decimals) — NOT wei. Declare it — an undeclared native movement is refused.
